result_text:
The purchase-order count per sales rep now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so the example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order and sales-order reports use. I also changed the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". Reps with no purchase orders in the period still come back with 0, in the same order.

`mvn -q -o test` ran the full offline suite and printed no errors. No existing test covers this method, and I did not add one or run the Anna/Bob example against a database.

Nothing is committed.
